title: Phase 2: Grades 6-7 two-voice harmony + real-time pitch visualization
description:
## Context
Builds on Phase 1 to implement Grades 6-7 (two-voice harmony) plus adds real-time visual feedback during recording.

## ABRSM Requirements
- Grade 6: User sings UPPER part (soprano) of 2-voice phrase, played twice
- Grade 7: User sings LOWER part (bass) of 2-voice phrase, played twice

## Tasks
1. Add dynamic voice_instructions_text() renderer in app.py (grade-specific instructions)
2. Add voice_target_indicator() component showing which voice to sing
3. Update www/voice-playback.js to handle 2-voice playback with volume balancing
4. Implement real-time pitch visualization:
   - Add canvas element to ui/components.py (create_voice_recording_indicator)
   - Add initLivePitchPlot(), updateLivePitchPlot(), clearLivePitchPlot() to www/microphone.js
   - Integrate updateLivePitchPlot() into existing pitch detection loop
   - Add CSS for recording indicator and canvas (www/styles.css)
5. Test Grade 6 (soprano target) and Grade 7 (bass target)

## Files to Modify
- app.py (add @render.ui functions for instructions and indicator)
- ui/components.py (update create_voice_instructions, create_voice_recording_indicator)
- www/voice-playback.js (add grade-specific playback logic)
- www/microphone.js (add live pitch plot functions)
- www/styles.css (add recording indicator and canvas styles)

## Technical Details
- Live plot: Rolling window of 100 frames (~5s), log scale 80-1000 Hz
- Only plot pitches with clarity > 0.85 to avoid noise
- Canvas size: 600x150px, auto-hide when not recording
- Volume balancing: Target voice 0dB, other voice -6dB

## Success Criteria
- Grade 6/7 play two voices, grade against correct voice
- Instructions clearly indicate which voice to sing
- Live pitch plot visible during recording, clears after stop

See: plans/2026-01-12-singing-grades.md sections 3, 6, 8

## Context

- Grade 7: Two staves (soprano gray, bass BLUE)

## Tasks

   - Add grade parameter to message data
   - Conditionally render 1, 2, or 3 staves based on grade
   - Apply color coding (blue = target voice, gray = context voices)
   - Add brace connector for multi-stave systems
2. Ensure key signatures display correctly for all grades
3. Test notation rendering for all 4 grades

## Files to Modify
- www/notation.js (update renderVoiceNotation handler)
- app.py (ensure grade passed in renderVoiceNotation message)

- VexFlow EasyScore API for notation rendering
- Color options: { color: 'blue' } or { color: 'gray' }
- Stem direction: up for soprano/alto, down for bass
- Use convertToVexFlowNotation() helper for MIDI->notation conversion

## Success Criteria

- Key signatures display correctly

## Context

## ABRSM Requirements
- Grade 8: User sings LOWEST part (bass) of 3-voice phrase, played twice
- Uses hybrid mode: 1-5 lead-in chords + strict 3-chord cadence (4-8 total)

## Tasks
1. Extend progression generator for 3-voice extraction:
   - Test extract_voices(progression, ['soprano', 'alto', 'bass'])
   - Verify voice leading produces valid 3-voice harmony (SAB, not SATB)
   - Add unit tests for 3-voice extraction
2. Update www/voice-playback.js to handle 3 voices:
   - Modify playVoicesSimultaneously() for 3-voice array
   - Volume balancing: bass 0dB, soprano -6dB, alto -6dB
3. Test Grade 8 end-to-end:
   - Generate soprano + alto + bass
   - User sings bass (lowest part)
   - Verify grading against bass only
   - Verify upper voices audible but distinguishable

## Files to Modify
- modules/music_theory/progression.py (verify 3-voice extraction)
- www/voice-playback.js (extend playback logic for grade 8)
- test_voice_singing_grades.py (add 3-voice tests)

## Technical Details
- Voice index mapping: 4-voice SATB [bass=0, tenor=1, alto=2, soprano=3]
- Extract indices [0, 2, 3] for SAB (skip tenor)
- All 3 voices must have same length (verify in tests)

## Success Criteria
- Grade 8 plays three voices simultaneously
- User can distinguish and sing bass part
- Grading correctly identifies bass voice
- All voices have equal length
